SELECT r.id, r.reservation_code, r.room_id, r.user_id, r.subject, r.attendee_count, r.remark, r.start_time, r.end_time, r.status, r.create_time, mr.name AS room_name FROM meeting_room_reservation r LEFT JOIN meeting_room mr ON mr.id = r.room_id AND mr.deleted = 0 WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND r.user_id = #{userId}
ORDER BY r.create_time DESC

SELECT r.id, r.reservation_code, r.room_id, r.user_id, r.subject, r.attendee_count, r.remark, r.start_time, r.end_time, r.status, r.create_time, mr.name AS room_name, ra.status AS my_attendee_status FROM meeting_room_reservation r INNER JOIN reservation_attendee ra ON ra.reservation_id = r.id AND ra.deleted = 0 AND ra.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN meeting_room mr ON mr.id = r.room_id AND mr.deleted = 0 WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1
AND ra.status = #{query.attendeeStatus}
AND r.start_time > NOW()
ORDER BY r.start_time DESC

SELECT r.id, r.reservation_code, r.room_id, r.user_id, r.subject, r.attendee_count, r.remark, r.start_time, r.end_time, r.status, r.create_time, mr.name AS room_name FROM meeting_room_reservation r LEFT JOIN meeting_room mr ON mr.id = r.room_id AND mr.deleted = 0 WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND ( (r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status IN (0, 1)) OR (r.status = 1 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM reservation_attendee ra WHERE ra.reservation_id = r.id AND ra.deleted = 0 AND ra.user_id = #{userId} )) )
ORDER BY r.start_time ASC
